findings: Gh schemas and collection now request PR author, thread resolver and a separate latest-comment selection including actor kind/body/timestamp/url. First-page truncation alone does not determine the newest speaker.

Collection still reads mutable GitHub state through authenticated gh subprocesses and paginates separate comment, thread and review requests; the combined payload is not a transactionally consistent remote snapshot. Missing pagination cursor fails. Explicit reply/resolve intents still perform sequential external writes.

Gates classify unresolved threads and unanswered reviewer follow-ups as blocking. Bot acknowledgements and review-body advisories remain distinct; advisory totals use the newest nonempty body per author and account for threaded locations.

Newest-comment evidence follows the latest selection, falling back to the first page only when complete. Unknown newest authorship does not create a follow-up gate; the receipt does not strengthen that policy or treat old payloads as fresh observations.
Closeout report adds follow-up, acknowledgement and advisory counts with decoding/construction defaults of zero for older reports. Compatibility defaults are not new hosted evidence.
Greptile parseScore becomes exported without changing its labelled fraction parser. String parsing does not authenticate a producer or grant a hosted verdict.
The closeout hosted-checks gate remains unknown; monitor and gh pr checks own the live result. Cached comments, schemas or local fixtures cannot substitute for required fresh checks.

reviewedAssertions: Reviewer follow-up blocks while 13 advisory findings do not.
A latest reviewer comment beyond the first comment page blocks and supplies the correct evidence.
Bot acknowledgement and reviewer self-resolution classify separately.
The hosted-checks closeout gate remains unknown.

limits: Five historical closeout deltas reviewed; supporting thread-state and body-signal semantics are tested but not claimed as full new-source review.
No live review/comment/status mutation was performed for this evidence.
No full hosted proof, complete transitive semantic closure, signed remote comparison or tuple qualification follows from fixture tests. All 13 broader obligations remain open.
